analysis:
CHANGELOG.md is documentation only: the v0.10.3 candidate heading is replaced with a v0.10.4 candidate section, and older release history is unchanged. No code, configuration or crypto behavior changes in the supplied evidence, so no regression can be demonstrated from these units.

The notes describe provider behavior that touches several threat-model areas. The source for these is outside the supplied evidence, so the changelog claims cannot be verified here.

1) Delta complete checkpoints (changelog head lines 55-57, 20) relate to T-041 and the SSD cache at-rest posture. They claim only the rows missing from a restored file are written, per-build namespaces are unchanged, and DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE_SSD_INCREMENTAL_CHECKPOINTS=0 reverts to full files. The implementation must keep HMAC-only lookup tags, AAD binding and the 30-minute TTL. Delta files need an authenticated parent link, to avoid replay or mix-up of base and delta files, and must be removed along with their parents on TTL and LRU sweeps.

2) Add-on hold hardening (lines 124-156) relates to TB-012, T-059, T-060 and A-018. The notes claim signer verification before a slot is taken, a 10-second line deadline, non-blocking reads that refuse FIFOs, and a model-load fence during a hold. The code must be checked to confirm these.

3) Re-registration of unauthorized connections (lines 21, 53) relates to T-053, T-057 and TB-011. This is a staggered idle re-registration that starts a new verification session. It is not shown to grant authorization, and the coordinator still decides. The code must confirm the idle gating and that jitter prevents a registration storm.

4) Grammar-constrained JSON output and forced tool_choice (lines 18-19, 98-112) are additive output-control features. The advertised capability list (tool_constraint_models) is provider-self-reported, which fits the existing adversarial-provider assumption.

No finding is raised because only the changelog is visible. Reviewers of the code diffs should check the claims above. I am not requesting deeper review for this documentation-only unit.
